run_richards_benchmark: run the Richards benchmark with a specified number of iterations and verify correctness
run_richards_s6_jit: run the Richards benchmark using the s6 JIT-compiled s2_run method for performance comparison
create_packet_linked_list: create a Packet object and append it to a linked list using the append_to method
schedule_tasks: schedule and execute all registered tasks in the Richards benchmark scheduler
create_idle_task: create an IdleTask with a given priority, input queue, initial state, and IdleTaskRec handle
